composition_rule: all bound catalog cases with every dependency in the realization edit set
paired_order_rule: R1-D9-order-v1; orders100..104; same order for every condition

rng_rule.derivation: SHA256(canonical compact JSON of namespace,seed,register_sha256,dataset,realization,role,stratum); first16 bytes big-endian
rng_rule.failure: abort whole draw on shortfall; no outcome-based replacement or seed retry
rng_rule.quota: largest remainder of remaining role-eligible strata; lexical ties
rng_rule.representative: first eligible row in register order per reviewed global entity
rng_rule.traversal: dataset declared order, realization 0..2, role declared order
